runpod.readOnly: Only a superuser can change RunPod settings (running a GPU costs money).
runpod.key.title: RunPod API key
runpod.key.description: The key lets WD run models on RunPod cloud GPUs and delete pods after the work. It is stored encrypted.
runpod.key.missing: No key yet — add one to pick a GPU and run the model.
runpod.key.label: RunPod API key
runpod.model.description: Model {{name}} ({{hf}}) runs on vLLM. Minimum VRAM: {{min}} GB, recommended: {{recommended}} GB. After the deployment pick it as the PDF parser in the knowledge base settings.
runpod.gpus.name: GPU
runpod.gpus.error: Could not load the GPU list (check the RunPod API key).
runpod.confirm.text: I will start {{model}} on a {{gpu}} GPU ({{vram}} GB VRAM) for about {{price}} USD/h. The deployment takes a few minutes (image and model download).
runpod.confirm.autoDelete: The pod is deleted automatically when parsing is done (after a few idle minutes), so you only pay for the working time.
runpod.confirm.autoParse: When the model is ready, parsing of the selected documents starts by itself.
runpod.alternatives.unavailable: GPU {{gpu}} is not available on RunPod right now.
runpod.alternatives.intro: Pick another GPU with the same or more VRAM (min. {{vram}} GB):
runpod.alternatives.none: No available GPU with the same or more VRAM. Try later or change the filters.
runpod.progress.title: {{model}} on {{gpu}}
runpod.progress.label: Deployment progress
runpod.progress.parseStarted: The model is ready — parsing of the documents has started.
runpod.progress.cost: Price {{price}} USD/h · cost so far about {{cost}} USD
runpod.status.starting: Pulling the image and starting the container… (usually 3–15 min; after 20 min we will suggest another GPU)
runpod.status.loading: Loading the model into GPU memory…
runpod.deployments.title: Deployments
runpod.prompt.title: Pod {{model}} is off
runpod.prompt.off: Parsing with this model needs a pod on RunPod. Do you want to start it? Parsing starts by itself after the deployment and the pod is deleted when it is done.
runpod.prompt.starting: Pod {{model}} is starting right now. Queue the parsing for when it is up?
runpod.prompt.askAdmin: Pod {{model}} is off. Ask an administrator to start it (Settings → RunPod) and run the parsing again.
runpod.prompt.lastGone: The GPU used last time ({{gpu}}, {{vram}} GB) is not available now. Below are other GPUs with the same or more VRAM — pick one.
runpod.prompt.lastReused: I will use the GPU picked last time: {{gpu}}. You can choose another one.
runpod.deployments.clearHistory: Clear history (removes ended deployments from the list)
runpod.deployments.manualOnly: Runs until you turn it off
runpod.deployments.autoOff: Turns off by itself after {{minutes}} min without tasks
runpod.confirm.manualDelete: The pod does not expire: it keeps running (and billing) until you turn it off in this section.
